It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Norwegian written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. Facts about Norway and Bergen are general knowledge and unchecked. review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Ring meg" (imperative) and "Jeg skal ringe deg" are both everyday. The message is written as direct speech.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Sam sender en melding til Anna. Meldingen er fra Sam.
sentences.english: Sam sends a message to Anna. The message is from Sam.

sentences.text: «Hei, Anna! Har du tid i morgen? Jeg vil treffe deg på kafé.»
sentences.english: "Hi, Anna! Do you have time tomorrow? I want to meet you at a café."

sentences.text: Anna svarer ikke. Hun er på klinikken. Hun jobber mye.
sentences.english: Anna does not answer. She is at the clinic. She works a lot.

sentences.text: Sam ringer til Anna.
sentences.english: Sam calls Anna.

sentences.text: Hallo, Sam! Jeg har ikke tid nå. Jeg jobber.
sentences.english: Hello, Sam! I do not have time now. I am working.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg skal ringe deg klokka fem.
sentences.english: I will call you at five o'clock.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det er bra. Jeg er hjemme klokka fem.
sentences.english: That is good. I am at home at five.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Klokka er fem. Sam tar telefonen.
sentences.english: It is five o'clock. Sam takes the phone.

sentences.text: Hei, Sam! Nå kan jeg snakke. Hva vil du?
sentences.english: Hi, Sam! Now I can talk. What do you want?
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Jeg vil treffe deg på kafé i morgen. Er det bra?
sentences.english: I want to meet you at a café tomorrow. Is that good?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: I morgen er det lørdag. Jeg har ikke planer.
sentences.english: Tomorrow is Saturday. I have no plans.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Det er bra! Hva er planen din?
sentences.english: That is good! What is your plan?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg skal sove tidlig, og så kommer jeg.
sentences.english: I will sleep early, and then I will come.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Bra! Klokka ti på kafeen?
sentences.english: Good! At ten at the café?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, klokka ti. Se, her er en melding fra Lars.
sentences.english: Yes, at ten. Look, here is a message from Lars.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Ja, gjerne. Hva sier meldingen?
sentences.english: Yes, please. What does the message say?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Lars sender: «Kan jeg komme også?»
sentences.english: Lars sends: "Can I come too?"
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Svar ja! Det er en bra plan.
sentences.english: Answer yes! That is a good plan.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: På lørdag treffer Sam Anna og Lars på kafeen.
sentences.english: On Saturday Sam meets Anna and Lars at the café.

sentences.text: Klokka er ti. De har tid, og de drikker kaffe og te.
sentences.english: It is ten o'clock. They have time, and they drink coffee and tea.

sentences.text: Lars svarer: «Takk, Sam!»
sentences.english: Lars answers: "Thanks, Sam!"

sentences.text: Bare hyggelig.
sentences.english: You are welcome.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Ja, vi er glade i dag.
sentences.english: Yes, we are happy today.
sentences.speaker: ana

sentences.text: Sam er glad. Han liker kafeen, og han liker Anna og Lars. Så ringer han til Marta og sier takk.
sentences.english: Sam is happy. He likes the café, and he likes Anna and Lars. Then he calls Marta and says thank you.

sentences.text: Før turen står Sam opp tidlig. Natten før sover han ikke mye. Hva gjør han? Han ber.
sentences.english: Before the walk Sam gets up early. The night before he does not sleep much. What does he do? He prays.

sentences.text: På veien hjem snakker Sam om turen. Veien er bra, og fjellet er høyt.
sentences.english: On the way home Sam talks about the walk. The road is good, and the mountain is high.

sentences.text: Norge er et langt land. I nord er det kaldt, og i sør er det varmt.
sentences.english: Norway is a long country. In the north it is cold, and in the south it is warm.

sentences.text: Hver kveld ber Sam en bønn: «Gud, tilgi synden min.»
sentences.english: Every evening Sam says a prayer: "God, forgive my sin."
